name: Demeures D'Orient Riad de Luxe & Spa
description: Boasting an ideal location in the heart of the Medina and easy to access by car, the brand new riad welcomes guests in a setting combining space and light. Marrakech-Menara Airport is just 3 km from the hotel. The 11 luxurious rooms and suites are spread across 1,000 m² and set around a patio and pool, which is the perfect place to enjoy a relaxing moment in the warmer hours of the day. The air-conditioned establishment welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and a cloakroom. Further facilities available to guests at this charming hotel include a hairdressing salon, TV lounge, café, restaurant, WLAN Internet access and a car park. For additional fees, guests may also take advantage of the room service, laundry service and bicycle hire service. Each room and suite features all the comforts and facilities to satisfy the most discerning of guests, while showcasing a typical Oriental style. The rooms feature charming handcrafted furniture, a large en suite bathroom with shower, bathtub and hairdryer, a double or king-size bed, individually regulated air conditioning and heating, and a private terrace. Other in-room amenities include a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, Internet access, a safe and a minibar. After a day of sightseeing, guest can enjoy some relaxing moments in the hammam, or unwind with a massage or spa treatment. There is a heated outdoor swimming pool with poolside snack bar and a sun terrace with sun loungers and parasols laid out ready for use. Further sport and leisure activities available to guests include tennis, golf, horse riding and biking (fees apply for all). The hotel organises entertainment programmes for adults and children (fees apply for both).
